info.description: Generated from docs/design/brandme/contracts/domain.schema.json (spec $id urn:brandme:design:domain:1.0.0) and chapter 03 endpoint inventory. Wire fields are snake_case. Operations marked x-brandme-status: reserved are contracts only; their owning lane implements them. Every JSON response carries X-Request-Id and X-Brandme-Environment headers.
